name: Kairos
gloss: Your answers put power and timing first: a strategic opening is an opportunity to act.

name: Shi (勢)
gloss: Power matters here as a position built over time; the priority is to establish leverage before forcing an outcome.

name: Grotian
gloss: Your answers give rules force only when they are backed by credible enforcement.

analogue.label: Hugo Grotius / De Jure Belli ac Pacis

name: Concert
gloss: Durable cooperation here depends on powerful actors accepting rules and restraint.

name: Satyagraha
gloss: Your answers treat shared beliefs as politically decisive: changing the public narrative can change what power achieves.

name: Musyawarah
gloss: Legitimacy here grows through patient consensus and cannot be secured by demand alone.

name: Dirigisme
gloss: Your answers give production and finance a leading role, with the state actively shaping the dependencies they create.

name: Dependencia
gloss: Reducing external dependence is central to resilience in this result.
